prompts.name: urban-entry
prompts.detail: URBAN ENTRY SPECIALIST. A deep slate cropped softshell jacket with a substantial folded collar and carefully articulated shoulders, compact fitted graphite chest carrier over a lighter gray technical shirt, one crimson shoulder tab and small crimson cuff pull. One shoulder has a sleek molded protective cap and the other remains fabric, producing subtle functional asymmetry. Flexible ribbed underarm inserts, believable gathered elbow folds, slim protective gloves with an integrated knuckle shell. Charcoal cargo trousers with shaped knees and compact mid-height lace-up boots. A close-cropped dark haircut, small communications earpiece, face fully visible. Make the clothing design distinctive and premium, particularly collar, jacket hem and sleeve construction.
prompts.prompt:
Create one polished full-body character concept image for an original competitive tactical FPS, ValStrike. Art direction: grounded tactical garment construction and believable adult human anatomy combined with the sophisticated sculpted shapes, appealing proportions, clean value grouping and restrained painterly materials of a high-end stylized hero shooter. Original design, not an existing game character. This must look like a beautifully authored character sculpture with flowing cloth, anatomical hands, nuanced face and smooth curved silhouettes; no primitive mannequin or visible low-poly facets.

One athletic adult male operator, early 30s, confident and observant, approximately realistic 7.5-head proportions, expressive angular face with natural eyes, subtle stubble. Functional and distinctive clothing with fabric thickness, seams, tension folds, overlapping tailored layers, fitted gloves, convincing boots. Separate woven fabric, soft rubber, leather and satin coated metal. Structure the design around a memorable silhouette and one purposeful asymmetric feature; avoid ornament everywhere. Charcoal, cool slate, muted steel and restrained crimson highlights, with enough mid-value material for readability. Professional high-quality game character concept, smoothly shaded detailed sculpt, controlled stylization. Clean relaxed stance, empty hands separated from body, full body including feet, three-quarter front view, slight 10-degree perspective at most. Soft neutral studio lighting, light gray background, minimal floor shadow. No text or logos, no weapon, no other figures. Avoid blocky or voxel forms, rectangular fingers, tube-shaped limbs, hard polygonal cloth, toy proportions, giant boots, robot hands, oversized armor, sci-fi glowing lines, excessive pouches, photographic skin pores and gritty military photorealism.

prompts.name: field-operative
prompts.detail: UNDERCOVER FIELD OPERATIVE. More human and agile than armored: a fitted desaturated slate utility overshirt with rolled sleeves and asymmetrical chest pocket, subtle graphite protective undershirt and streamlined shoulder harness. Natural muscular forearms and fitted dark leather/fabric gloves with a small crimson fastening tab. Tapered charcoal tactical trousers, discreet practical belt pouches, compact boots. Short swept-back textured dark hair, purposeful handsome face and restrained confident attitude. A single burgundy lining accent at the rolled sleeve and inner collar provides identity. Convincing cloth folding and dynamic tailored silhouette, no bulky plate armor.

prompts.name: recon-operator
prompts.detail: TECHNICAL RECONNAISSANCE OPERATOR. A lightweight cool-gray/slate technical jacket with a sculptural high collar and a folded hood resting behind the neck, narrow graphite protective vest with elegant functional panel lines, low-profile integrated headset. Asymmetric diagonal equipment strap and a small purposeful communication module, not many gadgets. Layered flexible sleeves with articulated fabric elbows, fitted refined tactical gloves. Slim charcoal trousers, compact knee reinforcement and light practical boots. Small desaturated crimson shoulder/cuff accents. Short textured hair, intelligent distinctive face fully visible. Athletic, light, precise silhouette, premium cloth construction; no glowing cyberpunk details or heavy armor.
